component: DSPACE production release artifacts, container image tags, Helm chart publication, and deployment verification
impact: Production served later 3.1-era frontend and changelog content while the footer, /healthz, and /livez still identified the deployment as prod v3.0.1. The service remained available and no data loss, saved-game corruption, credential exposure, privacy incident, or security compromise was detected, but users and operators could be misled about which release source was deployed.
rootCause: The primary release-integrity failure was mutable semantic image tagging: .github/workflows/ci-image.yml published both immutable branch-SHA tags and the semantic v<package-version> tag from ordinary eligible branch builds while the package version remained 3.0.1, allowing later source revisions to be published under v3.0.1. Production used v3.0.1 with image.pullPolicy=Always, so a restarted or recreated pod could pull different source content while runtime version surfaces still reported the package version. A separate published-chart mismatch was discovered during recovery: the OCI chart identified as dspace:3.0.1 contained later metrics and ServiceMonitor content that did not match the canonical v3.0.1 Git tag, complicating Helm reconciliation but not serving as the primary cause of the frontend drift.
resolution: The incident was resolved by an emergency image-only correction of the live Deployment to ghcr.io/democratizedspace/dspace:main-1a31a56, the immutable branch-SHA image for the canonical v3.0.1 commit 1a31a569aff2dbeb238e8c2688b9e85140d2077d. Two replacement pods started by 2026-07-23 16:13:28 PDT / 23:13:28 UTC, both resolved to sha256:23dbc573377549136c1f10b05706b3c176ffbabaf04a3194381a24752104a401, were ready with zero restarts, and restored the expected content. Sugarkube PR #2320 then made the immutable production image pin durable. Helm revision 8 still stores image.tag=v3.0.1, so Helm and live state remain intentionally drifted pending a controlled reconciliation using a newly published, never-overwritten chart version and the immutable image tag.
